decided_by: ake2l (requested typed APIs and component responsibilities); Codex implementation, independent Astra review before merge
rationale: Issue #540 extracts pure dependency-policy with named immutable selectors, selections and DependencyOwner identity/modules. Seven named shared type exports and an inner ownership matcher port make its API explicit. One model adapter preserves legacy ownership tuples and helper signatures; codecs retain input conversion, Core verdicts and reports shared selection. Enum placement permits its vocabulary owner. No baseline entry, measurement ceiling or accepted debt changes. docs/architecture/dependency-selection.md records responsibilities and compatibility limits.
